name: Nested Workflow Example
description: Parent workflow that calls a reusable child workflow. Demonstrates subworkflow nodes, parent_run_id tracking, and cascade controls.

metadata_json.purpose: Demonstrates workflow nesting with subworkflow task type
nested_workflow_features: parent_run_id FK on Run for tracking child runs
Cascade controls: pause/resume/cancel propagate to child runs
DAG drill-down UI for navigating between parent and child runs
setup_instructions: 1. First create a child workflow with is_reusable=true
3. Replace PLACEHOLDER_REPLACE_WITH_CHILD_WORKFLOW_ID in this file with the actual ID
4. Create the parent workflow using this definition
5. Start a run to see child workflow execution
suggested_checks: Create a reusable child workflow first
Update child_workflow_id reference in this file
Create parent workflow and start a run
Complete the 'prepare_data' task to trigger child workflow launch
Verify child run is created with parent_run_id set
Pause parent run - verify child run also pauses
Resume parent run - verify child run also resumes
Click on subworkflow node in DAG to drill down to child run
Cancel parent run - verify child run also cancels
